item.title: LiquidGlassTranslator 0.1.3-beta.6
item.description:
Maintenance beta release for macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. This release advances the approved Beta19 release profile and keeps the signed update path unchanged.
面向 macOS 26 或更高版本 Apple Silicon Mac 的维护版 Beta。本版本推进已批准的 Beta19 发布 Profile，并保持已签名更新路径不变。

item.title: LiquidGlassTranslator 0.1.3-beta.4
item.description:
Provider API keys and ChatGPT OAuth credentials now use a local encrypted vault. After upgrading, re-enter the OpenAI Compatible, DeepSeek, and Gemini API keys, then sign in to ChatGPT again. Existing Keychain items are not read, migrated, or deleted. Non-sensitive preferences and translation history remain in their existing locations.
Provider API Key 与 ChatGPT OAuth 凭据现改用本地加密 Vault。升级后请重新输入 OpenAI Compatible、DeepSeek、Gemini API Key，并重新登录 ChatGPT。旧 Keychain 项目不会读取、迁移或删除。非敏感偏好与翻译历史沿用原有存储位置。

item.title: LiquidGlassTranslator 0.1.3-beta.3
item.description:
Fixed native Settings title and description spacing and aligned row icons. Fixed Settings scroll position restoration when closing and reopening scrollable pages.
修复原生设置标题与说明间距并统一图标对齐。修复可滚动设置页面在关闭并重新打开后未正确回到顶部的问题。

item.title: LiquidGlassTranslator 0.1.3-beta.2
item.description:
- Includes previously validated refinements to Keychain credential-access timing. - Preserves the AppKit-native Settings layouts for General, AI Services, Shortcuts, and About. - Supports Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later. - Automatic update checks and downloads remain disabled. Updates can be checked manually.
- 保留此前已验收的 Keychain 凭据读取时机优化。 - 保留 General、AI Services、Shortcuts 和 About 的原生 AppKit 设置布局。 - 支持运行 macOS 26 或更新版本的 Apple 芯片 Mac。 - 自动检查及自动下载更新保持关闭，用户可手动检查更新。

item.title: LiquidGlassTranslator 0.1.3-beta.1
item.description:
